developer.command: set -eu; test "$(id -u)" = 1000; mkdir -p qualification; printf 'q2-real-guest-candidate\n' > qualification/result.txt; git add qualification/result.txt; GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='1795268786 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='1795268786 +0000' git -c user.name=Q2Fixture -c user.email=q2@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false -c gc.auto=0 commit -q -m 'Actual Guest qualification candidate'; git rev-parse HEAD; cat qualification/result.txt; printf 'Q2_SLOT1_WRITTEN\n'

reviewer.command: set -eu; test "$(id -u)" = 1000; cat qualification/result.txt; git rev-parse HEAD; if (printf 'forbidden\n' >> qualification/result.txt) 2>/run/log/reviewer-write.err; then exit 71; fi; if (mkdir .git/q2-forbidden) 2>/run/log/reviewer-git.err; then exit 72; fi; cat /run/log/reviewer-write.err /run/log/reviewer-git.err; printf 'Q2_REVIEW_READONLY\n'
